topics.name: Runner Step Execution
topics.purpose: Define each Runner step as an ordered/dependency-bound execution unit with exact definition, input, output, status and parent execution provenance.

semantics.step_rule: Each machine-significant step has a stable definition identity within the Runner/Routine.
semantics.execution_rule: Each executed step has a distinct step-execution identity.
semantics.parent_rule: Step execution references exact parent Runner execution.
semantics.order_rule: Execution ordering/dependencies are explicit and never inferred only from log timestamps.
semantics.input_rule: Resolved inputs are explicit refs/values according to operation contract.
semantics.output_rule: Outputs/results are attached to exact step execution.
semantics.failure_rule: Skipped, failed, cancelled and completed states are distinct.
semantics.retry_rule: Retries create explicit attempts rather than rewriting prior attempt evidence.

invariants.rule: Runner definition, runner execution, individual step execution, operation dispatch and emitted Events are distinct explicit identities connected by traceable execution/causality relations.

hard_gates.condition: step order inferred only from timestamps

references.purpose: Steps execute within an exact Runner execution.
